# bintables/and

> && : short-circuit with a conditional jump; produces 0 or 1.

truck [bintables](../bintables.md) · [source](../../../registry/bintables/and.pkg) · translates [std/and](../std/and.md)

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm
{left}
test rax, rax
jz {L.done}
{right}
test rax, rax
setnz al
movzx eax, al
{L.done}:
```
